titulo: 8 Ways You Answer an Unknown Number, Ranked by Cella
caption: YouTube only (a medio in 16:9, no Short and no Reel). What goes out is the YouTube title and the description.
descripcion:
A phone rings with a number nobody saved, and most people stare at it for three rings before doing something a little strange. Cella ranks eight ways of answering it, all about behavior, by how well the call ends.

The eight are archetypes, not people and not brands, and every one was somebody's best idea at the time. The scores (ends well, out of ten) and the whole ranking are Cella's opinion and nothing in it is a study. The one thing the best ones share, by her reading: one short sentence ready before the phone rings.
